scope: Post-confirmation fixed32 diagnostic only; no formal latency replacement
queries: Same diag32.qid and exhaustive oracle as final guarded diagnosis
trace: cuda,nvtx,osrt; sample=none; cpuctxsw=none; NVTX capture formal.query_pass only; capture-range-end=stop
binary_identity: Same final guarded binary hashes; no instrumentation rebuild
admission: After complete formal gate; same UUID/NUMA, locked serial processes, no foreign activity

report: Kernel/API counts and inclusive durations, GPU work interval union, memory-copy payloads and raw report hashes
boundaries: Inclusive CUDA API time overlaps GPU work and may include waiting/spinning; not measured CPU arithmetic. Temporal GPU coverage is not SM utilization. No NCU DRAM/L2-traffic attribution or standalone cache-module timer is claimed.
